config_missing.title: gastpagina.yaml is missing
config_missing.description: Create {path} with the rooms and devices, then call `gastpagina.reload`. Until then guests cannot control anything.

config_invalid.title: gastpagina.yaml is invalid
config_invalid.description: The file could not be read: {error}. The previous devices keep working until it is fixed.

wrong_domain.title: Wrong kind of entity for {device}
wrong_domain.description: {entity} is not a {expected}. The device is skipped and unreachable for guests.

duplicate_key.title: Duplicate key in gastpagina.yaml
duplicate_key.description: {device} occurs more than once (or is reserved). Only the first one counts.

missing_entity.title: Entity for {device} does not exist
missing_entity.description: {entity} does not exist in Home Assistant. The device shows as unavailable on the page.

limits_invalid.title: Invalid temperature limits
limits_invalid.description: climate_limits in gastpagina.yaml is wrong ({error}). The default 16–22 °C applies.

code_too_short.title: Code too short for booking {title}
code_too_short.description: The code of booking "{title}" is shorter than {min_length} characters and does not work. Pick a longer one.

duplicate_code.title: Same code for two bookings
duplicate_code.description: "{first}" and "{second}" overlap and share a code. Neither works until one changes.

calendar_missing.title: Guest page calendar is missing
calendar_missing.description: {entity} does not exist (any more). Without it no code works.

revoke_sessions.name: Revoke sessions
revoke_sessions.description: Signs guests out. Without a booking: everyone.

booking.name: Booking
booking.description: Title or uid of the calendar event.

not_loaded.message: The guest page is not loaded.
